title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.36066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. translated_title: AerialDojo-200K：面向开放世界空中目标物搜索的大规模基准测试套件
translated_abstract: 开放世界空中目标物搜索是一项基础性但具有挑战性的任务，要求空中智能体自主探索大规模、非结构化的三维环境，并根据语义描述或参考图像到达目标物体，而不是遵循特定路线的指令。然而，该任务的研究仍处于起步阶段，依赖于规模小、特定于环境的基准测试，且这些基准测试具有异构的动作空间和数据格式。这些局限性阻碍了大规模训练和跨基准评估，限制了空中智能体的可扩展性和泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AerialDojo-200K，这是一个面向开放世界空中目标物搜索的大规模基准测试套件，其场景数量是现有该任务最大基准的3倍，任务实例数量是18.7倍。具体而言，我们构建了涵盖四个场景族和21个场景（原文在此处截断）的42个仿真场景……
tldr: 该论文提出了AerialDojo-200K，一个面向开放世界空中目标物搜索的大规模基准测试套件，其场景数量和任务实例数量分别是现有最大基准的3倍和18.7倍，解决了以往小规模、异构基准阻碍大规模训练与跨基准评估的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search featuring 3 times more scenes and 18.7 times more task instances than the largest existing benchmark, addressing the limitations of small, heterogeneous benchmarks that hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation.
